name: load_event_voice_set

stack.evidence: func_001E1420 uses the earlier value to select a six-byte world path prefix, uses the top value as the event number, queues the resulting file load, and decrements Script stackTop by two

notes: The handler formats voice/event/<world>_<event>.vset, allocates its destination, and queues an asynchronous load whose completion flag is polled by command 257. Every JP call is immediately followed by command 257; representative calls load world 0 event 106 in al02.ard and world 0 event 13 in al01.ard.
